overview.heading: Why this project?
overview.body:
Use this section to give the context that did not fit on the poster: the biological question, why it matters, and how the two experiments fit together.

You can use **bold**, *italic* and [links](https://example.org). Leave an empty line to start a new paragraph.

experiments.title: CRISPR-Cas experiment
experiments.intro: What was the goal of the CRISPR experiment, and what did we edit?

methods.title: Guide RNA design
methods.what: What we did: which target, how many guides, which tools were used to design them.
methods.why: Why we chose this approach over the alternatives.

methods.title: Delivery of Cas9 and gRNA
methods.what: What we did: e.g. plasmid, RNP or viral delivery, cell type, conditions.
methods.why: Why this delivery method suited our cells and our question.

methods.title: Microscopy
methods.what: What we did: microscope, objective, channels, time-lapse interval.
methods.why: Why imaging was the right readout for this experiment.

methods.title: Image analysis
methods.what: What we did: software (e.g. Fiji), segmentation, what we quantified.
methods.why: Why these measurements answer our question.

code.title: Quantification of the microscopy data
code.description: Reads the measurements exported from Fiji and compares the conditions.
code.code:
# Placeholder: replace with your own script
library(ggplot2)

data <- read.csv("crispr_measurements.csv")

ggplot(data, aes(x = condition, y = intensity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal()

code.title: Analysis of the light response
code.description: Measures the response before and after light stimulation.
code.code:
# Placeholder: replace with your own script
data <- read.csv("opto_measurements.csv")

summary(data)
t.test(response ~ light, data = data)
